# MCP tools: Overview and changes

<!-- Generated by `sidekick.mcp.export_tool_reference` from `contracts/mcp-tools.generated.json`. Do not edit by hand. -->

[MCP tool reference](index.md) | 3 model-visible tools. The tools of this area that only the MCP App rooms call are on the [app-only page](app-only.md).

## `get_today_brief`

Use this when the user asks how today stands, or a scheduled morning or evening check needs the day at a glance.

Access: read

Scopes: requires no single scope; the answer holds only the parts whose read scope the session has (`journal:read`, `shopping:read`, `tasks:read`).

Returns: `BriefOutput` with `day` (date), `diary` (BriefDiary or null), `shopping` (BriefShopping or null), `tasks` (BriefTasks or null).

No parameters.

## `show_work_changes`

Call this at most once, as the last tool call, after a series of Work writes (domain, project, task or step creates and updates) in the same turn.

Access: read

Scopes: requires `projects:read`.

Returns: `WorkChangesOutput` with `card` (WorkCard).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `refs` | array of object | yes | 1 to 25 items |
| `refs[].id` | uuid | yes | - |
| `refs[].kind` | string | yes | one of `domain`, `project`, `task`, `step` |

A nested field is listed under its parent as `parent.field`; `parent[].field` is a field of each item in the list. Required means required inside its parent.

## `list_recent_changes`

Use this when the user asks what they changed last, or to undo it.

Access: read

Scopes: requires no single scope; the answer holds only the parts whose read scope the session has (`contacts:read`, `journal:read`, `projects:read`, `shopping:read`, `tasks:read`).

Returns: `ChangesOutput` with `changes` (array of ChangeRecord).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | integer | no | default `20`; 1 to 20 |
